label: Chapter 04

sentences.en: The mind evolves through predictable stages over time.
sentences.zh: 心智会随着时间推移，沿着可预测的阶段不断演化。

sentences.en: When you're born, you're like a little survival sponge that absorbs whatever beliefs you can (which is why it's easy to convince you of almost anything at a young age).
sentences.zh: 刚出生时，你就像一块小小的求生海绵，吸收一切你能接触到的信念（这也是为什么人在年幼时几乎什么都容易相信）。

sentences.en: It's hard to deny that the mind is wildly malleable at birth.
sentences.zh: 不可否认，出生时的心智具有极强的可塑性。

sentences.en: As you grow older, your beliefs harden and crystalize.
sentences.zh: 随着年龄增长，你的信念会逐渐变硬、结晶固化。

sentences.en: This has been documented enough in models like Maslow's Hierarchy, Greuter's stages of ego development, and Graves's Levels of Existence.
sentences.zh: 这一点已经在马斯洛需求层次理论、格鲁特的自我发展阶段、格雷夫斯的存在层次等模型中得到了充分记录。

sentences.en: I did my best to simplify them here, and I have created a full write-up of my own that synthesizes these models into Human 3.0 model with various AI prompts to uncover your level of development and a path forward (open in a tab to read or save for later).
sentences.zh: 我已尽力在此处将它们简化，并且写了一篇完整的文章，将这些模型综合成 Human 3.0 模型，还附上了各种 AI 提示词，用来发现你所处的发展层次以及前进的路径（可以在新标签页中打开阅读，或保存下来以后再看）。

sentences.en: 1. Impulsive— No separation between impulse and action. Black and white thinking. I.e. A toddler hits when frustrated.
sentences.zh: 1. 冲动型——冲动与行动之间没有分隔，非黑即白的思维方式。比如：幼儿一受挫就动手打人。

sentences.en: 2. Self-Protective— The world is dangerous and you learn to look out for yourself. I.e. A kid learns to manipulate to avoid punishment.
sentences.zh: 2. 自我保护型——世界是危险的，你学会了只顾自己。比如：孩子学会耍手段来逃避惩罚。

sentences.en: 3. Conformist— You are your group and its rules feel like reality itself. I.e. Someone who genuinely cannot understand how others could hold different beliefs.
sentences.zh: 3. 从众型——你就是你所属的群体，它的规则感觉就是现实本身。比如：一个人真心无法理解别人怎么会持有不同的信念。

sentences.en: 4. Self-Aware— You notice you have an inner life that doesn't match the exterior. I.e. Sitting in church, realizing nobody else seems to notice the disconnect between what's preached and how people act.
sentences.zh: 4. 自我觉察型——你注意到自己的内心生活与外在表现并不一致。比如：坐在教堂里，意识到似乎没有别人注意到所宣讲的与人们实际行为之间的脱节。

sentences.en: 5. Conscientious— You build your own system of principles and hold yourself accountable to them. I.e. Leaving your job to start a business, despite everyone saying it's a bad idea.
sentences.zh: 5. 尽责型——你建立起自己的原则体系，并要求自己对它负责。比如：辞掉工作去创业，尽管所有人都说这是个坏主意。

sentences.en: 6. Individualist— You see that your principles were shaped by context and start holding them more loosely. I.e. Realizing your "core values" are mostly what your parents and culture installed.
sentences.zh: 6. 个体主义型——你看到自己的原则是被环境塑造的，开始不再那么紧抓不放。比如：意识到你的“核心价值观”大多是父母和文化灌输给你的。

sentences.en: 7. Strategist— You work with systems while aware of your own involvement in them. I.e. Leading an organization where you notice your own biases shaping every decision.
sentences.zh: 7. 战略家型——你在系统中工作，同时意识到自己也身处其中、参与其中。比如：领导一个组织时，你注意到自己的偏见正在影响每一个决策。

sentences.en: 8. Construct-Aware— You see all frameworks, including your identity, as useful fictions. I.e. Holding your identity almost like a favorite jacket – useful, comfortable, but knowing you can take it off.
sentences.zh: 8. 建构觉察型——你把所有框架，包括你的身份认同，都看作有用的虚构。比如：对待自己的身份就像对待一件最喜欢的夹克——有用、舒服，但你知道自己可以随时脱下它。

sentences.en: 9. Unitive— Separation between self and life dissolves. I.e. Work, rest, and play feel like the same thing from the same source.
sentences.zh: 9. 合一型——自我与生命之间的分隔消融了。比如：工作、休息和玩乐感觉像是来自同一源头的同一件事。

sentences.en: For most people reading this, I would assume you hover between 4 and 8, which is a huge gap.
sentences.zh: 对于大多数读到这里的人，我猜你们大概处在 4 到 8 之间，这是一个巨大的跨度。

sentences.en: Those closer to 8 are reading this are doing so to either learn something or pass time in a non-destructive way.
sentences.zh: 那些更接近 8 的人读这篇文章，要么是为了学到点什么，要么是用一种无害的方式打发时间。

sentences.en: The good thing is, it doesn't really matter what stage you are in, because moving through any of these stages is the same: it's integrating new information that changes your goals.
sentences.zh: 好消息是，你处在哪个阶段其实并不重要，因为穿越其中任何一个阶段的方式都是一样的：整合新的信息，从而改变你的目标。

sentences.en: The more you do this, the faster you will expand.
sentences.zh: 你越是这样做，成长得就越快。

title_en: IV – The life you want lies within a specific level of mind
title_zh: 四、你想要的人生，藏在某个特定的心智层次里

vocab.example_en: Young minds are highly malleable and shaped by their surroundings.
After years of experience, her ideas about leadership finally crystalized.
He tried to manipulate the conversation to get what he wanted.

vocab.def_zh: 尽责的；认真的；有良心的
vocab.example_en: She is a conscientious student who always finishes her work on time.
In that quiet moment, he felt a unitive sense of connection with everything around him.
